description: This file implements centralized API error handling middleware for an ASP.NET Core application, providing exception-to-HTTP response mapping, detailed logging, and consistent problem detail responses.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: A static class providing methods to configure global exception handling and to convert exceptions into standardized HTTP responses with ProblemDetails.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Registers middleware in the WebApplication to handle uncaught exceptions globally and convert them into appropriate ProblemDetails responses.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Maps an exception to a standardized HTTP response with a ProblemDetails body, including appropriate status code, title, detail, and trace information.
